commands: set -e; if ! command -v android >/dev/null 2>&1; then brew tap android/tap; brew install android-cli; fi; command -v android; android --version || android version || true

set -e; SDK="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; android --sdk="$SDK" info || true; printf '%s\n' '--- emulator help ---'; android --sdk="$SDK" emulator -h; printf '%s\n' '--- emulator list ---'; android --sdk="$SDK" emulator list || true
set -e; printf '%s\n' '--- create help ---'; android --sdk="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" emulator create -h
